rotowire.headline: Maxey amassed 26 points (10-15 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 11 assists, four rebounds, two steals and two blocks across 36 minutes in Monday's 126-107 win over the Bulls.
rotowire.story: Although he struggled from three-point range, Maxey was nearly perfect from inside the arc. The star point guard led all players in scoring and assists, securing his first double-double of the season. He also turned in another productive performance on the defensive end and tallied multiple steals for a second straight game. Maxey has yet to score fewer than 26 points in a game this season and continues to make an impact on both ends of the floor.
rotowire.description: Maxey amassed 26 points (10-15 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 11 assists, four rebounds, two steals and two blocks across 36 minutes in Monday's 126-107 win over the Bulls.

fantasy.projection: Maxey is coming off a campaign in which he averaged career highs in all six fantasy counting categories: points, assists, rebounds, steals, 3-pointers and blocks. He was fifth in fantasy points per game and fourth in total fantasy points and is still only 25 years old. The 76ers made big moves this offseason, bringing in both Jaylen Brown and LeBron James. While this increases the team's chances to contend, it likely puts a cap on Maxey's volume upside.
